Thanks for the heads-up. A few guidance notes from People Partners:
- Redactions: replace customer personal names with initials and keep company-level attribution where consent exists. If consent is unclear, use anonymized descriptors ("major retail partner").
- Format: we prefer the one-page highlights + appendix model. Put manager quotes in the appendix and leave inline callouts in the one-pager as short paraphrases.
- Timing: we need the completed packet (one-pager + appendices) by EOD June 14 so our reviews and compliance checks can finish before the 15th packet cut.

Drive template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-promo-templates

If you want a quick redaction pass, I can run it but would need the appendix doc by June 14 10:00 PT.

Wendy S.
People Partners (external consultant)
